verses.1: For the destruction of David’s kingdom.
verses.2: I cried out to the LORD, and He heard my voice.
verses.3: And he led me out of the cave in Shaan. He placed me on a rock, with my feet resting on the ground.
verses.4: And he will give a new song as a hymn to our God. Many will fear and revere Him, and they will trust in Him.
verses.5: The branches of the tree that Jehovah placed there from His own will, and they did not turn towards the roots and the stumps.
verses.6: You have done great things, O LORD God. Your glory and your wisdom are ours. There is no need for us to say anything more about you. Let it be known by those who write about you.
verses.7: Sacrifice and offerings… You did not desire them. You cut off my ears; I was punished for my sins. You did not ask for forgiveness.
verses.8: So I said, “Here I come, in the midst of a book that is written upon me.”
verses.9: To do what you desire, O God, that is what I wish to do. Your laws are within my reach.
verses.10: In my service to righteousness, among a large crowd, I see that my lips cannot speak. Jehovah, you know this.
verses.11: Your righteousness does not cover me; in my heart, I do not acknowledge your truth and your forgiveness. I do not accept your kindness and your truth for a large crowd.
verses.12: You, Jehovah, do not withhold your mercy from me. Your kindness and truth will always be my strength.
verses.13: For they covered me with so much suffering that I couldn’t even see myself anymore. My head and heart were filled with pain.
verses.14: May the LORD save me! May He be my helper.
verses.15: They will dig and search together, those who seek to fulfill their souls’ desires. They will be destroyed, and those who desire evil will fail.
verses.16: They will put a mark on their heels. Those words said to me, “Hah!”
verses.17: May they be rich and happy in you. All those who seek your help will always say, “The LORD will exalt those who love you.”
verses.18: And I am poor and destitute; my Lord, please consider me as your helper. Please help me, O God! Do not turn away from me.
